name: host-tool-surface-sources
title: Three notions of the host tool surface, with no single source
description: Measured while wiring the fourth mode in: NETWORK_TOOLS holds eight names, the representative tool catalog carries a different set, and work-mode.test.ts hardcodes eight more. The test failed a mode for denying web_search, which the catalog carries. One list with one source is the fix; today the three disagree and nothing reconciles them.
